Question: Using NHANES from 2005 to 2008  we will run a logistic regression  where the predictor is  monocyte count/lymphocyte count*10 and outcome is proliferative retinopathy (PR). Covariates include age, sex, race categorized as non-hispanic white, non-hispanic black, mexican american, and other. We will include  patients whose age is equal or more  than 40 years old, has diabetes defined as as one of the following (1) Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) ≥ 6.5%,(2) Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) ≥ 7 mmol/L; (3) during an oral glucose tolerance test, 2-h plasma glucose ≥ 11.1 mmol/L; (4) self-report questionnaire data indicating physician diagnosis of diabetes; and (5) “Yes” to take diabetes pills to lower blood sugar or “Yes” to taking_insulin_now.  Exclude participants with missing data on 4 levels retinopathy severity worse eye, and missing values of monocyte count or lymphocyte count and who said “No” for  4 levels retinopathy severity worse eye.
Structured Question:
Analysis Type: logistic regression

Dataset: NHANES

Period of Interest: 2005-2008

Inclusion Criteria:
- age >= 40 years old
- (Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) >= 6.5% OR Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) >= 7 mmol/L OR 2-h plasma glucose >= 11.1 mmol/L OR self-report questionnaire data indicating physician diagnosis of diabetes OR take diabetes pills to lower blood sugar = "Yes" OR taking_insulin_now = "Yes")

Exclusion Criteria:
- missing 4 levels retinopathy severity worse eye
- missing monocyte count
- missing lymphocyte count
- 4 levels retinopathy severity worse eye = "No"

Covariates:
- age
- sex
- race categorized as:
    - "non-hispanic white"
    - "non-hispanic black"
    - "mexican american"
    - "other"

Predictor:
- monocyte count/lymphocyte count*10 calculated as:
  (monocyte count / lymphocyte count) * 10

Outcome:
- proliferative retinopathy (PR) = 1 if "4 levels retinopathy severity worse eye" indicates proliferative retinopathy; 0 otherwise
